If you own an ICICI Lombard health insurance plan or are planning to buy one, this video gives you the data you need before making that decision. We break down every key metric — claim settlement ratio, claims paid ratio, incurred claims ratio, complaint data, and how fast they settle claims. This is the kind of analysis your insurance agent will never show you.

CHAPTERS
00:00 Data Highlights In Today's Video
01:48 Claim Settlement Ratio of ICICI Lombard 2026
03:54  Claims Paid Ratio of ICICI Lombard 2026
05:43  Incurred Claim Ratio of ICICI Lombard 2026
07:38 Complaints Per 10k Claims of ICICI Lombard 2026
11:52 Claim Settlement Speed of ICICI Lombard 2026
13:47 Video Conclusion 

This video is part of the Health Insurance Report Card 2026 series by Insurance Impact, where we review every major health insurance company in India using the same methodology, same metrics, and same grading system. The goal is simple — help you find the best health insurance company in India based on actual claims data, not marketing promises.

Here's what we cover in this ICICI Lombard review:

Claim Settlement Ratio (CSR) — Out of all health insurance claims filed with ICICI Lombard in 2025-26, how many were actually settled? We calculate this using the adjusted formula that accounts for opening and closing outstanding claims, giving you the real picture instead of inflated numbers.

Claims Paid Ratio (CPR) — Settling a claim is one thing, but how much money did ICICI Lombard actually pay compared to what was claimed? This metric reveals whether the company pays full claim amounts or cuts them down during settlement.

Incurred Claims Ratio (ICR) — For every Rs.100 of premium collected, how much is ICICI Lombard paying back in claims? Too low means the company might be rejecting too many claims. Too high means rising costs that could affect future premiums. The ideal zone is 70-85%.

Complaints per 10,000 Claims — How many policyholders had to formally complain about their claim experience? We look at claims-related complaints only and also check how many complaints were fully accepted by the company, meaning they should have been resolved without the customer needing to complain at all.

Claims Settlement Speed (Ageing) — How fast does ICICI Lombard settle health insurance claims? We break this down into time buckets — within 1 month, 1-3 months, 3-6 months, and beyond. The best health insurance companies settle 95% or more claims within 30 days.
Important disclaimers: This analysis covers health insurance claims only. All data is taken directly from ICICI Lombard's public disclosure documents. The grading criteria, weightages, scoring methodology, and ratings are entirely Insurance Impact's own research. This video and the entire series is not sponsored by any insurance company, aggregator, or brand.

Frequently Asked Questions:

We calculate the exact CSR using adjusted figures from their latest public disclosure, accounting for outstanding claims at the start and end of the year.
